notes.title: Demo Hotfix 1.2 & First Major Update: Paths and Voices
notes.content:
We've had an incredible few weeks learning about what everyone's thoughts on the Shoni Island demo are! Utilizing the feedback we've gotten in our community Discord server, we're rolling out another hotfix as well as the first major patch since the demo's launch: Paths and Villager Voices!

[h2]Firstly, check out the notes for Demo Hotfix 1.2:
[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed building menu crash
[*] Puzzle loading/saving fix
[*] Right click destroy/slam conflict bug fix
[*] Building text info missing fixed
[*] fixed not all villagers sleeping/waking up
[*] fixed camera movement continues when pausing/autosaving etc
[*] fixed collision issues with some buildings
[*] fixed constructors not using pickups to construct
[*] fixed farmland destroyed plot not re-placeable/causing a crash on highlight
[*] fixed tree planting (loading/saving not tested)
[*] fixed not all UI hiding on demo end screen
[*] fixed demo final end screen (day 5) still showing password/continuable
[*] added demos for farm view and tree planting
[*] fixed some pickups not spawning on ground
[*] fixed adventurous villager wandering
[*] prevented sleepers from being launched (for now)
[*] fixed demo puzzle 1 blocking villagers
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/5cafdc357db7902298714b5bf4c50d6e20b416d6.png[/img]

Now, let's jump straight into the major update!

[h2]Paths[/h2]

Players will not be able to create pathways that villagers can use to get from place to place. To get started making a path:

[list]
[*] LMB to make a point
[*] RMB to undo last point
[*] Spacebar to confirm (takes the last LMB point as the final one)
[*] RMB on a path section to remove that section
[/list]
Just as they can create them, players will also be able to destroy paths by pressing RMB over them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/d2df09ebd1c4af93d0f5ebaaffa1adcd6ffe5fdc.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/5748a873c3ca0c63a46479a3f54ab177a3840d59.gif[/img]

[h2]Villager Voices[/h2]

Lastly, new voice lines were recorded for villagers, so zoom in to see if you can listen in on a conversation or two next time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/dc279afc48b47d24497a9eea16e3041fbad4f4e1.gif[/img]

[list]

notes.title: Shoni Island's Demo is Available Now
notes.content:
The demo for Shoni Island is finally here, and I'm honestly both terrified and excited to see what everyone thinks of it.

Step into an immersive, hour-long demo experience that drops you right into the heart of the game! Harness the power of the god hand, shape the fate of your settlement, and uncover the secrets of survival. But the real highlight? Meeting the island’s most peculiar resident: Howard!

We would also really appreciate it if you could join [url=https://discord.gg/4h3VVqDnyM]our community Discord server[/url], where we update players on the game itself and even provide them with exclusive access to extra parts of the demo.

Thank you so much for your support, and get ready for a hands-on adventure unlike any other!

- Sean, Shoni Island Lead Dev

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000215/9d04837110ad4ce0d35c89a72ecca64b47249620.png[/img]

notes.title: The Indie Diarist Podcast Guest: Sean Menzies
notes.content:
Golden Horde Studios founder Sean Menzies sat down with The Indie Diarist to talk about the indie game studio's upcoming title, Shoni Island!

"In this episode, I spent some time with Sean Menzies, founder of Golden Horde Studios, who's working on a cosy sim / resource management game called Shoni Island. Our chat covered anything from the state of industry to the legacy of legendary god game Black & White, and I enjoyed every minute of it! Hope you like it! 🎒💛"

[h3][url=https://open.spotify.com/episode/44Fq7U9o2eBAythLaQKsxm]Check out the full episode on Spotify!
